item.text: I’m checking a tight set of sources for 8B.2 now: budget language, technocratic appointments, grievance/admin reforms, and the main counterevidence on patronage and politicization.

item.query: Reuters India 2024 budget jobs rural programs infrastructure deficit Reuters July 2024 Modi coalition budget

action.query: Reuters India 2024 budget jobs rural programs infrastructure deficit Reuters July 2024 Modi coalition budget
queries: Reuters India 2024 budget jobs rural programs infrastructure deficit Reuters July 2024 Modi coalition budget
PIB 2024 AI-assisted grievance redress last mile service delivery Modi
Reuters 2024 India appoints RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra Reuters December 2024 Modi

item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Yes. In 2024, Modi’s program was translated into concrete budget lines, named schemes, administrative reforms, and technocratic appointments. The main weakness is that several of those mechanisms were bent toward coalition management, media control, and opaque political finance rather than neutral institution-building.

**Best Positive Evidence**
- [India’s Modi spends billions on jobs, key allies in first budget after election](https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-spends-billions-on-jobs-key-allies-in-first-budget-after-election/2187546/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-07-23  
  **Claim:** The first post-election budget turned the program into spending priorities: about $32 billion for rural programmes, $24 billion over five years for jobs, and more than $5 billion for coalition states, while also lowering the fiscal deficit target to 4.9% of GDP.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2, 8B.1

- [India budget shifts spending priorities while keeping fiscal deficit in check](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/india-budget-shifts-spending-priorities-while-keeping-fiscal-deficit-in-check-3530722)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com  
  **Date:** 2024-07-23  
  **Claim:** The budget explicitly balanced jobs and rural development with deficit control, showing an implemented fiscal strategy rather than a purely rhetorical one.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2, 8B.1

- [AI-assisted grievance redress, last mile service delivery approved](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1997326&lang=2&reg=48)  
  **Publisher:** Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions  
  **Date:** 2024-01-18  
  **Claim:** The government approved funding for AI-assisted CPGRAMS, service-delivery reengineering, and “last mile” delivery, which is a concrete administrative mechanism for implementation and correction.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2

- [CPGRAMS: 3 Years, 70 Lakh Grievances Solved](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2088830&lang=2&reg=3)  
  **Publisher:** Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions  
  **Date:** 2024-12-30  
  **Claim:** The government said CPGRAMS solved large volumes of grievances and was being upgraded with chatbot, voice-to-text, auto-escalation, and machine-learning tools. That is evidence of a live institutionalized enforcement and feedback mechanism.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2

- [Shri Sanjay Malhotra takes over as RBI Governor](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=59281)  
  **Publisher:** Reserve Bank of India  
  **Date:** 2024-12-11  
  **Claim:** Modi’s government appointed a career IAS officer with deep finance and taxation experience to lead the RBI, which supports a technocratic staffing pattern for a core economic institution.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2

- [Government appoints members for new Finance Commission](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/indian-government-appoints-members-for-new-finance-panel-3287402)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com  
  **Date:** 2024-01-30  
  **Claim:** The Finance Commission was filled with experienced officials and economists, showing implementation through professional institutions rather than purely personal patronage.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2

- [India unveils incentives to create jobs in first budget after election](https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/india-unveils-incentives-to-create-jobs-in-first-budget-after-election-3530319)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com  
  **Date:** 2024-07-23  
  **Claim:** The government set out a $24 billion, five-year job-creation push plus rural spending in the first post-election budget, which is a concrete multi-year plan rather than a slogan.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2, 8B.1

- [Digital Agriculture Mission approved](https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2050966&lang=2&reg=48)  
  **Publisher:** Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare  
  **Date:** 2024-09-02  
  **Claim:** The government approved a data-driven Digital Agriculture Mission using registries, crop estimation, and digital public infrastructure, showing program-to-institution translation in a major sector.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2

- [Health ministry first 100 days note](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressNoteDetails.aspx?ModuleId=3&NoteId=153215&lang=1&reg=3)  
  **Publisher:** Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare  
  **Date:** 2024-09-28  
  **Claim:** The government rolled out expanded Ayushman Bharat coverage for seniors, U-WIN, more medical seats, and digital health registries, which is a concrete service-delivery agenda with identifiable instruments.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2

- [Women empowerment remained in focus for rural development ministry in 2024](https://theprint.in/india/women-empowerment-remained-in-focus-for-rural-development-ministry-in-2024/2425889/)  
  **Publisher:** PTI via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-12-31  
  **Claim:** Rural programs and housing were operationalized through women-centric implementation, including a majority of MGNREGS women beneficiaries and PMAY-G ownership patterns favoring women.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2

**Best Counterevidence**
- [India’s Modi spends billions on jobs, key allies in first budget after election](https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-spends-billions-on-jobs-key-allies-in-first-budget-after-election/2187546/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-07-23  
  **Claim:** The same budget that implemented the program also visibly routed more than $5 billion to coalition-led states to win back voters and retain support, showing that execution was partly patronage-driven.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2, 7B.10

- [Explainer: what were India’s electoral bonds and how did they power Modi’s party](https://theprint.in/india/explainer-what-were-indias-electoral-bonds-and-how-did-they-power-modis-party/1969006/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-02-16  
  **Claim:** The anonymous electoral-bonds system heavily benefited the BJP and obscured funding flows, which weakens the case that the regime’s governing machinery was being translated through clean, arm’s-length institutions.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2, 7B.10

- [India top court puts on hold unit for fact-checking online content about govt](https://theprint.in/india/india-top-court-puts-on-hold-unit-for-fact-checking-online-content-about-govt/2009612/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-03-21  
  **Claim:** The government tried to create a fact-checking unit to police online content about government business, and the Supreme Court stayed it, which shows an implementation mechanism aimed at information control rather than neutral governance.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2, 7B.10

- [India’s poll panel orders Modi’s BJP, opposition Congress to show restraint in campaign](https://theprint.in/india/indias-poll-panel-orders-modis-bjp-opposition-congress-to-show-restraint-in-campaign/2096809/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-05-22  
  **Claim:** The Election Commission had to censure communal campaigning, including Modi-linked rhetoric, which shows enforcement was external and corrective rather than fully self-disciplined.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2, 8B.1

- [India’s Modi to focus on jobs, incomes in first budget after election setback](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indias-modi-to-focus-on-jobs-incomes-in-first-budget-after-election-setback-3524300)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com  
  **Date:** 2024-07-18  
  **Claim:** Even before the budget, Reuters described the post-election plan as a way to mend ties with voters amid uneven growth and food-price pressure, which suggests the implementation agenda was reactive as much as strategic.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.2

**Search Gap**
I did not find one single 2024 document that ties all of Modi’s priorities together into a unified implementation roadmap with full timelines, benchmarks, and enforcement architecture. The evidence is instead distributed across budgets, sectoral schemes, and appointments.

**Net Read**
Modi clearly translated his 2024 program into concrete budgets, schemes, and technocratic staffing. The limitation is that the same machinery was partly used for coalition bargaining, narrative control, and politically selective allocation, so implementation was real but not cleanly depoliticized.
